explication_en: TypeAdapter reads the rules of TypeAdapterConfig then chooses an adapter such as ClassAdapter, derived from BaseAdapter, which compiles a mapping expression. The EFCore and DependencyInjection packages plug into it, and Mapster.Tool generates code from the attributes of Mapster.Core.
